metadata.title: Tandoori Chicken Pizza Recipe | How To Make Chicken Tandoori Pizza | Chicken Recipe | Varun Inamdar
metadata.description:
Learn How To Make Chicken Tandoori Pizza Recipe, an Indian Pizza Recipe from The Bombay Chef - Varun Inamdar only on Get Curried. Make this popular Tandoori Chicken Pizza in a simple, quick and easy method, at your home and share your experience with us in the comments below.

Ingredients:-
For Instant Chicken Tandoori:-
1 tbsp. oil
1 tablespoon lemon juice
½ cup plain yoghurt
2 Chicken breast boneless, thinly sliced
1 tsp. Chilli powder
½ tsp. Turmeric powder
½ tsp. Chaat masala
1 tsp. Kasuri Methi
1 tsp. Ginger-garlic paste
Salt as required

2 round pizza bases (Click on the link for Pizza Base recipe:- https://youtu.be/Whh6tKrvKwA )
4 tbsp. Pizza sauce

For Toppings:-
1 cup tandoori chicken
1 small red onion rings
Handful spinach leaves
Handful mushrooms
1 cup assorted bell peppers, cut into rings
½ cup grated pizza cheese/mozzarella

Method:-
- In a bowl mix the boneless chicken pieces with yoghurt, chaat masala, Kasuri methi, red chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice and salt. Keep aside for 15-20.
- Heat a grilled pan and heat oil in it.
- Grill the chicken on this pan on high flame for a minute on each side and then transfer it to a plate.
- On a pizza base spread a generous amount of pizza sauce followed by spinach leaves, mozzarella cheese, bell peppers, onion rings, button mushrooms and finally the chicken tandoori.
- Bake this pizza on a baking tray at 200°C for 7-8 minutes.
- Splash some Olive Oil and serve.

Delicious Chicken Tandoori Pizza is ready to eat! HAPPY COOKING!!!

nodes.plm_caption: The video features a variety of actions including food preparation, knife demonstrations, and other culinary-related activities.  Most of the video is composed of several different short video sequences that are quick cuts of a cook or preparing food.  The segment shows ingredients being added to a bowl, chicken being grilled, ingredients being added to pizza dough and pizza being finished.  The background is often a kitchen with some personal items and the camera is handheld with minimal cuts, several shots are close up shots of ingredients or food items.  There is a man in a yellow shirt who occasionally speaks, and at times appears in the background or foreground of the shot.  The video ends with the same man in front of the kitchen counter.  The only audio is the man's voice throughout the clip.  The clip is clearly from a video on a cooking show or youtube channel with music playing in the background.

summary.brief: A chef in a yellow shirt prepares, bakes, and serves a chicken tandoori pizza.
summary.detailed: The video opens with upbeat music and the chef greeting the audience. He cuts boneless chicken breast into long strips, then mixes the strips in a bowl with yogurt, lemon juice, chaat masala, kasuri methi, red chili powder, turmeric, ginger‑garlic paste and salt, allowing the mixture to marinate for about fifteen minutes. He heats a grill pan, adds a little oil, and quickly sears the marinated chicken on high heat, giving each side a minute of grill marks while the pieces remain slightly undercooked. After removing the chicken to a plate, he retrieves a ready pizza base, spreads a generous layer of tomato‑herb pizza sauce, and tops it with fresh spinach leaves, mozzarella cheese, sliced bell peppers, onion rings, button mushrooms, and finally the grilled tandoori chicken. He carefully slides the assembled pizza onto a baking tray and bakes it in a pre‑heated oven at 200 °C for 7–8 minutes until the cheese melts and the crust becomes crisp. Once out of the oven he drizzles a little olive oil over the hot pizza, presents the finished dish, waves and smiles at the camera, and the video ends with a black screen displaying a white copyright notice for Rajshri Entertainment Private Limited.

action.detailed: Marinate chicken strips with yogurt and spices, grill them briefly, spread sauce on a pizza base, layer spinach, mozzarella, bell peppers, onion rings, mushrooms and the grilled chicken, then bake until the cheese melts and the crust is crisp.

summary.brief: A chef in a yellow shirt prepares, grills, assembles, and bakes a chicken tandoori pizza.
summary.detailed: The video begins with the chef cutting boneless chicken breast into long strips and placing them in a bowl. He adds yogurt, lemon juice, chat masala, kasuri methi, red chilli powder, turmeric, ginger‑garlic paste and salt, then mixes everything until the chicken is well coated and lets it marinate for about fifteen minutes. He heats a grill pan, drizzles a little oil, and grills the spiced chicken on high heat, turning it so that grill marks appear on each side. The cooked chicken is transferred to a plate. Next, the chef takes a ready pizza base, spreads a layer of tomato‑based pizza sauce, and tops it with fresh spinach leaves, mozzarella cheese, sliced bell‑pepper rings, onion rings and button mushrooms. The grilled chicken pieces are scattered over the toppings. He carefully slides the assembled pizza onto a baking tray and bakes it in a pre‑heated oven at 200 °C for 7–8 minutes until the cheese melts and the crust turns crisp. Finally, he drizzles a little olive oil over the hot pizza, presents the finished chicken tandoori pizza and takes a bite.

The chicken is then marinated with various ingredients, including yogurt, garam masala, coriander powder, chili powder, lemon juice, and butter, before being grilled on a gas griddle pan. The chicken is cooked until golden brown on both sides and then removed from the grill.  The chicken is flaky and juicy and has a rich, slightly smoky flavor. The video also shows the finished dish, a plate of chicken wings garnished with lemon wedges and served with a side of tandoori dipping sauce. Overall, the video provides a clear and concise guide to making delicious chicken wings with tandoori seasoning.

summary_sent_to_llm.title: Tandoori Chicken Pizza Recipe | How To Make Chicken Tandoori Pizza | Chicken Recipe | Varun Inamdar
summary_sent_to_llm.description:
Learn How To Make Chicken Tandoori Pizza Recipe, an Indian Pizza Recipe from The Bombay Chef - Varun Inamdar only on Get Curried. Make this popular Tandoori Chicken Pizza in a simple, quick and easy method, at your home and share your experience with us in the comments below.

Ingredients:-
For Instant Chicken Tandoori:-
1 tbsp. oil
1 tablespoon lemon juice
½ cup plain yoghurt
2 Chicken breast boneless, thinly sliced
1 tsp. Chilli powder
½ tsp. Turmeric powder
½ tsp. Chaat masala
1 tsp. Kasuri Methi
1 tsp. Ginger-garlic paste
Salt as required

2 round pizza bases (Click on the link for Pizza B
summary_sent_to_llm.root_summary: The video opens with upbeat music and the chef greeting the audience. He cuts boneless chicken breast into long strips, then mixes the strips in a bowl with yogurt, lemon juice, chaat masala, kasuri methi, red chili powder, turmeric, ginger‑garlic paste and salt, allowing the mixture to marinate for about fifteen minutes. He heats a grill pan, adds a little oil, and quickly sears the marinated chicken on high heat, giving each side a minute of grill marks while the pieces remain slightly undercooked. After removing the chicken to a plate, he retrieves a ready pizza base, spreads a generous layer of tomato‑herb pizza sauce, and tops it with fresh spinach leaves, mozzarella cheese, sliced bell peppers, onion rings, button mushrooms, and finally the grilled tandoori chicken. He carefully slides the assembled pizza onto a baking tray and bakes it in a pre‑heated oven at 200 °C for 7–8 minutes until the cheese melts and the crust becomes crisp. Once out of the oven he drizzles a little olive oil over the hot pizza, presents the finished dish, waves and smiles at the camera, and the video ends with a black screen displaying a white copyright notice for Rajshri Entertainment Private Limited.

You evaluate YouTube videos for a video-understanding benchmark.

You will be given an Action100M-style summary of one video: title, description,
a hierarchical GPT-written summary of the whole video, and a deduplicated list
of action labels extracted at multiple levels of the video.

Your job is to judge:

1) DOMAINS — does this video clearly belong to either of these target domains?
   - "kitchen": a person preparing food in a kitchen-like setting
     (cooking, baking, food prep — NOT eating reviews, NOT pet-food prep,
     NOT food-product unboxing, NOT restaurant vlogs).
   - "manipulation": a person performing hand-object manipulation tasks
     with clear physical goals: assembly/disassembly, repair, crafting,
     tool use, packing, sorting. The video must show clear procedural
     manipulation, NOT just incidental hand movement (e.g. a vlog where
     someone holds things while talking does NOT count).
   A video can match neither, one, or both. Be strict — when in doubt,
   say "neither".

2) NUM_DISTINCT_EVENTS — count the number of *semantically distinct*
   sub-events (procedural steps) you see in the action list. Merge
   paraphrases of the same step into one. Ignore generic narration steps
   like "speak to camera" or "display title".

3) IS_GOOD_CANDIDATE — true only if BOTH:
   - at least one target domain matches
   - num_distinct_events > 3 (the video shows a real multi-step procedure)

Always return strict JSON in the requested schema.
